4: Unit 2 is what Arc gives the engine.
Installing the Connected Machine agent makes the server an Azure Resource Manager resource, with a system-assigned managed identity whose credential the agent manages.
What the instance uses as its Entra identity depends on the version.
On sequel Server 2025, it's the Arc server's managed identity, used as the instance's primary managed identity.
Microsoft Learn says only system-assigned identities are supported.
On sequel Server 2022, it's an app registration with a certificate kept in Azure Key Vault, which the agent downloads with the machine's identity.
On either version, Entra authentication needs sequel Server 2022 or later, is disabled by default, and isn't supported on a failover cluster instance.
And neither replaces the Windows account the sequel Server service runs as.
